findings.publicNavigation: Research browser observed a target absent from the model and generation first pages but present with its advertisement ID on the observed Long Range AWD grade page, then followed its actual individual-ad and Korean Encar links. This is a concrete missing navigation path; raw third-party HTML is not captured by that tool.
findings.userDiagnostic: Two searches, three results, one result mentioning the full plate, six checked candidates all with another plate. The supplied diagnostic lacks newer component/version fields, so it does not establish which client/server version ran or prove one unique upstream failure cause.
findings.sourceCapDefect: A synthetic actual-handler reproduction showed official negative skips consuming all external source-page slots. Fixed by separating ignored sources from attempted network fetches.
findings.searchDifference: Research search and Tavily are different providers. The old second query required an additional raw model phrase and site syntax; the replacement retains a quoted full plate and supported domain filtering without increasing basic-search calls.

behavior.branches: Observed immediate model-generation-grade anchors only; grade/model hints rank siblings but never establish identity or exclude fallback branches. No fabricated catalogue slugs or advertisement IDs.
behavior.structuredHints: Only selected make/group and optional valid grade; no raw freeform vehicle name, VIN or customer information. Invalid optional grade is omitted.
behavior.markdown: Bounded plate-local Markdown windows prioritize candidate IDs and source links. Search text never substitutes for original HTML proof. New plate-local candidate IDs also qualify for up to three known-ID source checks, without ID arithmetic.
behavior.officialAndPriceGuards: Official mismatch/inactive/deleted/unknown state remains authoritative; external-only evidence cannot trigger verified price reuse, screenshot, OCR or sale-price change.
behavior.diagnostics: Fixed client/resolver release values, discoveryProvided boolean and bounded branch/skipped-source counters. No full plates, advertisement IDs, URLs, customer data or credentials are logged in diagnostics.
behavior.list: The acknowledged-link save still updates current scoped table/cards while preserving drafts and view state.

browserChecks: actual observed grade-leaf lookup before generic search
source provenance persisted and restored in a fresh workspace
held save has zero list icons; exact ACK updates underlying table/cards
dirty drafts, page, search, view mode and peer vehicles retained
zero external-only OCR or price mutation
source hashes equal at test start/end
validation.independentReview: No additional concrete defects; 378 API/parser/auto-price and 357 parser/frontend tests passed (overlapping, not added to total).
validation.legacyBrowserFixtures: Removed historical UI release pins while retaining behavior and execution-source hash checks.

production.vehicleReadScope: Only the requested owner vehicle selected make/group/generation/grade/subgrade and link-presence metadata were read for comparison. No customer, financial or credential payload was retrieved.
production.deployment: Exact source and production merge checks are recorded after publication in the private final receipt.

limitations: Actual production Cloudflare raw HTML retrieval, Tavily response/configuration and authenticated end-to-end lookup success remain unverified from the restricted execution environment. Browser HTTP/auth/database responses are synthetic.
Observed grade-page evidence establishes a missing route; it does not prove the precise cause of every supplied runtime diagnostic or prove all catalogue pages can be read.
Bounded traversal and request limits intentionally remain; failure to read or find a match is not proof no advertisement exists.
No claim of stale client or server is made solely from missing diagnostic fields. New safe version fields allow the next actual response to distinguish versions.
